subject: Tomorrow’s event is focused on your success
body:
Last chance to register for our career-advancing global open house. 

                              Hi Anwar,                            

Northeastern University's Virtual Graduate Open House <https://ter.li/oh-int-rem4-f26> begins tomorrow, and you can still attend. Register and join us from 7 a.m.--2 p.m. ET.                            


REGISTER NOW <https://ter.li/oh-int-rem4-f26>
                              This email is your last chance to register and connect with faculty, support staff, and current students to see if Northeastern is the right place for you, your career, and your goals.

Register today <https://ter.li/oh-int-rem4-f26> and look at the agenda <https://graduate.northeastern.edu/virtual-open-house-agenda/?utm_medium=email&utm_source=slate&utm_campaign=em-cvn-evg-glo-grad-net-all-def-ole-2026_09_22-fall_virtual_open_house&utm_content=reminder_nr4_intl> to start planning your schedule.

We hope to (virtually) meet you tomorrow.

                              Sincerely, 

Northeastern Graduate Admissions
                              Northeastern University
